description: This file defines a serializer class 'TimeOnlyCodec' for serializing and deserializing the 'TimeOnly' struct in the Orleans.Serialization framework, specifically for .NET 6.0 or greater. It includes methods for writing and reading 'TimeOnly' values to and from a wire protocol, utilizing buffer writers and readers.

classes.name: TimeOnlyCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for serializing and deserializing TimeOnly values.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a TimeOnly value into the buffer, writing the field header and the ticks value.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a TimeOnly value from the buffer, reading the ticks and constructing a TimeOnly instance.
